_note: Each project routes its own source repos to its own hub repo. `sources` empty means provisioned but not yet syncing - the project has not installed the source App. hubBotLogin is only consulted when `viewer` cannot be resolved. labelPrefixes selects which source labels mirror onto the discussion; the prefix is maintainer vocabulary and is stripped, so `area/api` becomes `api`, which must already exist as a label in the hub repo. Empty disables label mirroring. `routes` (optional, per project) is an ordered list of {label, categoryName, categoryId}: an issue carrying `label` lands in that category, first match in config order wins, no match falls back to hub.categoryId.
